question: Where’s the closest café lying along the route toward River Stone Resorts and Bear Paw Suites, Estes Park, CO from Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center, Denver, CO?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Denver Health Medical Center Emergency Department Trauma Center%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%River Stone Resorts and Bear Paw Suites%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_route AS ( -- Create a 1000-meter buffer around the straight line route to define "along the route" SELECT ST_Buffer(rl.geom::geography, 1000)::geography AS geom FROM route_line rl ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois p, buffered_route br, end_point ep WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, br.geom) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ep.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
